oracle.note: the reference itself, submitted as an answer -- what the scoring chain gives a perfect answer, and therefore the top of this case's scale

round_trip.submission: gt/gt.step imported and re-exported with cadquery -- what a submitted program necessarily produces
round_trip.note: the number `harness/run.py --model mock/oracle` reproduces on this case, because that is the submission it builds

baseline.submission: a solid block of the whole assembly's bounding box, exported with cadquery
baseline.note: the floor of this case: what the ruler gives an answer that knows only the overall size. It is 0.0 because a single block places no part types at all, and asm_v1 scores per part type. `harness/run.py --model mock/dumb` submits a 10 mm box instead -- a different trivial answer, so its score need not equal this one.
